message: On this grey afternoon, I love to keep my phone charged up with a power bank while we chat in our family group text. It's a cozy way to stay connected, even when the lights go out. Plus, it's always fun to share what everyone’s up to in our little offline adventures! How do you keep the good vibes rolling during a power outage? 😊
scene: a phone charging from a power bank on a windowsill on a grey afternoon (late evening, warm lamp light)
